info.title: Translation Management Service
info.description:
API-first translation management: locales, tagged keys, search and a
versioned, always-fresh JSON export for frontend i18n.

- Successful responses use a `{ data, meta? }` envelope (except the raw export).
- Errors are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` and always include `requestId`.
- bigint ids are serialised as strings.

id.description: Token id (bigint serialised as a string).

token.description: The bearer token. Shown exactly once; only its SHA-256 is stored.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when this is the last page.

scopes.description: Scopes to grant. Omit to get every scope the user may grant. Narrow it (e.g. ["export:read"]) for least-privilege tokens.

ttlSeconds.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Defaults to AUTH_TOKEN_DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS.

code.description: BCP 47 code (language[-Script|-REGION]); stored in canonical casing.

isActive.description: Inactive locales are rejected on writes and not exported.

id.description: bigint id, serialised as a string

Primary CTA on the payment step

values.description: Locale code → translated text. Every code must be an active locale.

tags.description: Context tags (deduplicated). Unknown tags are created. Max 20.

values.description: Merged by locale (upsert). A null value removes that locale; omitted locales are untouched.

tags.description: Replaces the full tag set when provided.
